sn46.41:1.3: Ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā tisso vidhā pajahissanti || sabbe te sattannam bojjhaṅgānam bhavitattā bahulīkatattā || ||
